method: odoo-cli controls plan, apply (with the plan hash) and status for K01-K05 and K07, then K08, on one company; each switch read where Odoo keeps it, and Odoo's behaviour behind each control exercised through an independent JSON-RPC oracle, as the administrator and as a purchase user the run made; every setting and lock date restored through the CLI afterwards. Statuses and names only.

checked: an invoice of the locked period cannot be reset to draft
a new out_invoice dated in the locked period is posted after the lock
a new in_invoice dated in the locked period is posted after the lock
a posted bill cannot be deleted
a customer over its limit is warned on a draft
status ON, the CLI still reads with its API key
an employee's password is refused over RPC
the administrator's API key still works
lock dates restored through the CLI
the oracle sees the first settings
the oracle sees the first lock dates
